anomalies.observed: The schematic shows the cathode node of D2, which is the servo power rail feeding C1-C4, connected to both pin 1 and pin 2 of J3 and J8. No GND connection is shown to J3 pin 1 or J8 pin 1.
anomalies.expected: D2 should feed the servo power rail only to J3/J8 pin 2. Pin 1 of a standard 3-pin servo header should be GND, not tied to the servo supply.

anomalies.impact: Servo ground pins are tied to +5V instead of GND. Standard servos plugged into J3/J8 would not have a proper return path and could be damaged or create a supply short.

parsed.summary: Anomaly detected: the servo header ground pins (J3/J8 pin 1) appear shorted to the D2 servo power rail, leaving no GND on the servo connectors.
